**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/24 (Wed) 23:39
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Electronic Performance Support Systems (EPSS) are computer-based systems that provide on-the-job support to workers by supplying them with information and tools to help them perform their tasks more effectively.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] EPSS can be used in a variety of settings, including education, training, and business.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The use of EPSS has been shown to improve performance, increase efficiency, and reduce errors.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Several studies have examined the factors that influence the acceptance and adoption of EPSS.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) are two frameworks that have been used to understand the adoption of EPSS.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] According to TAM, the perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use of a technology are important determinants of acceptance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] TPB posits that attitudes, subjective norms, and perceived behavioral control influence an individual's intention to adopt a technology.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ashraf et al. (2017) found that interfunctional communication is an important predictor of acceptance of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, which are a type of EPSS.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Chen and Popovich (2003) found that effective communication between different functional units is critical for the successful implementation of CRM systems.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Other factors that influence the acceptance of EPSS include user satisfaction, the presence of adequate training and support, and the alignment of EPSS with organizational goals and objectives.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructional designers play a key role in the development and implementation of EPSS.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Boling et al. (2017) conducted a study on the core judgments made by instructional designers in practice.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Klein and Kelly (2018) identified a set of competencies that instructional designers should possess in order to effectively design and implement EPSS.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] EPSS can be implemented using a variety of technologies, including desktop computers, laptops, and mobile devices.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Chao (2019) found that the intention to use mobile learning, which is a type of EPSS delivered via mobile devices, is influenced by factors such as performance expectancy, effort expectancy, and social influence.
